scripts.package: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cd .. && zip -qr qr-code-generator/dist/illustrator-qr-code-generator-1.0.0.zip qr-code-generator -x 'qr-code-generator/.git/*' 'qr-code-generator/dist/*' 'qr-code-generator/node_modules/*' 'qr-code-generator/.DS_Store'
